licensure.disciplinary_grounds.rationale: These nine buckets capture the dominant clusters across all states: fraud in obtaining or using a license, criminal convictions, substandard or negligent care, substance abuse or physical/mental impairment, improper controlled-substance prescribing, sexual or financial exploitation of patients, aiding unlicensed practice or supervision failures, false advertising and improper fee arrangements (splitting, kickbacks, overcharging), and failure to comply with board orders, reporting requirements, or other administrative obligations.

profession_specific.license_status_types.rationale: These nine buckets capture the dominant functional groupings across all states: standard active practice, non-practicing status (inactive/retired), short-term or pending credentials, graduate training permits, scope-constrained licenses, charitable-service licenses, academic/faculty credentials, non-clinical administrative practice, and cross-border or institution-specific special-purpose licenses.
